home.how.1.title: Create your profile

matcher.title: Smart Matcher
matcher.subtitle: Answer a few questions — get personalised, ranked matches.
matcher.state.help: State schemes (like SVMCM, OASIS, Kanyashree) are limited to their own domiciles.
matcher.category.help: Many schemes are reserved for SC / ST / OBC students. OBC-A / OBC-B count as OBC.
matcher.income.help: Most scholarships have income caps — this one number unlocks or blocks the majority of schemes.
matcher.course.q: What are you studying right now?
matcher.marks.q: Your aggregate in the last qualifying exam?
matcher.marks.help: Merit scholarships (SVMCM, INSPIRE…) apply cut-offs. Skip if unsure — we'll flag those matches as assumptions.
matcher.gender.help: Girls' scholarships (Kanyashree, Pragati, Begum Hazrat Mahal…) are reserved for female students.
matcher.details.q: Do any of these apply to you?
matcher.details.minority: I belong to a notified minority community
matcher.details.disability: I have a benchmark disability (40%+ certificate)
matcher.details.single_girl: I am my family's only girl child
